correlations.notes: Across Bachelor's-level majors. Pearson r. Observational.

headline_findings: Across 226 Bachelor's majors, median 5-year earnings are $58,198 on $22,976 of debt.
Debt and earnings are only weakly linked across majors (r=0.051): more debt doesn't buy more pay.
The highest-earning field, Computer Engineering, out-earns the lowest by $74,864 at the 5-year mark.
12 well-paid fields also sit in the AI 'danger zone' — above-median pay and high task exposure.
